overviewHtml:
AI features add usage to your Dynatrace bill, and it is not obvious which part drives it. This dashboard makes AI-related billing events visible in one place. For official figures, use your Account Management portal.

What you get

  • Total cost based on list price
  • Breakdown per billing unit: AI Units
  • Related query cost
  • Related Standard Function calls
setupHtml: Total cost (based on list price) and breakdown per billing unit: AI Units, related query cost, and related Standard Function calls.
getStartedHtml:
1. Import the dashboard JSON into the Dashboards app
  2. Pick the timeframe you want to review
  3. Compare the figures with your Account Management portal
